proved_within_synthetic_fixture_scope: Human container activations, AI mechanisms, source-linked Wisdom and ASI governance can be active on the same Sequence decision node without collapsing their ownership.
System possession of Wisdom does not preload a Human Actor View; Wisdom enters the Human view only through an explicit communication event.
Wisdom retrieval/application is not part of the submission execution threshold and cannot grant authorization.
AI tool selection and preparation do not replace Human authorization or ASI permission/governance.
Denied Human authorization blocks execution even when AI and Wisdom favor action-readiness.
Incomplete artifact state opens a remediation/reverify Sub-Sequence and keeps the parent waiting.
Failed provenance blocks execution and routes to provenance repair/source review.
A locally successful submission Sequence may close while the external acceptance outcome remains UNKNOWN.
Local closure creates a future external-decision seed rather than keeping or reopening the closed submission Sequence.
non_claims: The fixture performs no real submission.
The test does not prove theological consensus or universal applicability of the bounded Wisdom source.
The test does not prove AI cognitive quality or real-world safety.
The test does not close P2-HUMAN, P2-AI, P2-WISDOM, P2-ASI or Phase-2.
